name: LocalGov Open Referral
description: Support for modules creating Open Referral UK endpoints.
project_description:
This module is currently developed on Github and mirrored here whilst projects from LocalGov Drupal are migrated to Drupal.org. Please file issues on the Github issue queue . 

 Open Referral is an agreed standard for sharing content about community services. This module provides the required endpoints and administration to configure content to be displayed in the standard.

 To create Open Referral output you will at least need to map some content to 'Organisations' and 'Services'. LocalGov Directories has submodules to automatically configure this for you. You can also add other directory entry types. @todo Link to documentation.
